tracker-monitoraggio-collaudo.description: SSDA-1209 - Monitoraggio Paper Tracking per collaudo avvio nuova gara recapito
tracker-monitoraggio-collaudo.query: WITH date_context AS ( SELECT 20261118 AS start_partition_key, CAST(date_format(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER) AS end_partition_key ), iun_monitorati AS ( SELECT DISTINCT iun FROM cdc_analytics_database.test_collaudo_recapito ), tracker_raw AS ( SELECT t.trackingId, i.iun, t.state, t.businessState, t.events, t.updatedAt, t.stream_eventname, t.kinesis_dynamodb_ApproximateCreationDateTime AS cdc_timestamp FROM cdc_analytics_database.pn_paper_trackings_json_view t JOIN iun_monitorati i ON regexp_extract(t.trackingId, 'IUN_([^.]+)', 1) = i.iun CROSS JOIN date_context d WHERE CAST( CAST(t.p_year AS VARCHAR) || LPAD(CAST(t.p_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || LPAD(CAST(t.p_day AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS INTEGER ) BETWEEN d.start_partition_key AND d.end_partition_key ), tracker_latest AS ( SELECT trackingId, iun, state, businessState, events FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY trackingId ORDER BY cdc_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST, updatedAt DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM tracker_raw ) x WHERE rn = 1 AND (stream_eventname IS NULL OR stream_eventname <> 'REMOVE') ), tracker_events AS ( SELECT t.trackingId, t.iun, t.state, t.businessState, e.statusCode, e.statusTimestamp, e.requestTimestamp, e.createdAt AS event_created_at FROM tracker_latest t LEFT JOIN UNNEST(t.events) AS u(e) ON TRUE ), tracker_last_event AS ( SELECT trackingId, iun, state, businessState, statusCode, statusTimestamp, requestTimestamp FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY trackingId ORDER BY event_created_at DESC NULLS LAST, requestTimestamp DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM tracker_events ) x WHERE rn = 1 ), errors_raw AS ( SELECT e.trackingId, e.created, e.category, e.details_cause, e.details_message FROM cdc_analytics_database.pn_paper_trackings_errors_json_view e JOIN tracker_latest t ON e.trackingId = t.trackingId CROSS JOIN date_context d WHERE e.type = 'ERROR' AND e.stream_eventname = 'INSERT' AND CAST( CAST(e.p_year AS VARCHAR) || LPAD(CAST(e.p_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || LPAD(CAST(e.p_day AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS INTEGER ) BETWEEN d.start_partition_key AND d.end_partition_key ), errors_aggregated AS ( SELECT trackingId, COUNT(*) AS numero_errori, array_join(array_agg(COALESCE(category, '') ORDER BY created DESC), ' - ') AS category_error, array_join(array_agg(COALESCE(details_cause, '') ORDER BY created DESC), ' - ') AS details_cause_error, array_join(array_agg(COALESCE(details_message, '') ORDER BY created DESC), ' - ') AS details_message_error FROM errors_raw GROUP BY trackingId ) SELECT i.iun, t.trackingId AS requestID, t.statusCode AS ultimo_status_code, t.statusTimestamp AS ultimo_status_datetime, t.requestTimestamp AS ultimo_clientrequesttimestamp, t.state AS tracker_state, t.businessState AS tracker_businessstate, IF(t.trackingId IS NULL, NULL, COALESCE(e.numero_errori, 0)) AS numero_errori, e.category_error, e.details_cause_error, e.details_message_error FROM iun_monitorati i LEFT JOIN tracker_last_event t ON i.iun = t.iun LEFT JOIN errors_aggregated e ON t.trackingId = e.trackingId ORDER BY i.iun, t.trackingId;
